name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, this trial marks your passage into true service to the Light. You master the sacred power to return fallen companions to life.
As an Alliance defender, you train among Stormwind's paladins at the Cathedral of Light. Their work preserves the lives of Alliance defenders and strengthens the kingdom's defenses.

faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity is a culminating trial for paladins learning to wield the Holy Light. Here, an initiate reports to Duthorian Rall after proving capable of channeling the Light to restore the fallen.
faq.q: What is The Tome of Divinity?

faq.answer: Duthorian Rall is a high-ranking paladin trainer at Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He oversees paladin initiates and judges their readiness to wield sacred rites.

aliases: what did symbol of life do
faq.answer: The Symbol of Life is a sacred focus for calling on the Light to restore the dead. Mastering its power proves an initiate is ready to wield the paladin's power of resurrection.
faq.q: What is the Symbol of Life?

faq.answer: Henze is an ally who fell in the field and was restored with the Symbol of Life during an initiate's trials. The deed showed the paladin's resolve and faith to reverse death.
Resurrection is one of a paladin's highest honors. Through deep faith and attunement to the Holy Light, a paladin learns to call fallen companions back from death's threshold.
faq.q: How does a paladin earn the power of resurrection?

faq.answer: The script is the Defias papers taken from the island. Once Duthorian Rall has looked them over, Gazin Tenorm will carry them to the King's advisors as proof that the Defias have infiltrated Elwynn.
faq.q: Why is the script being taken to the King's advisors?

sections.body: After restoring the fallen Henze with the Symbol of Life in the field, an aspiring paladin returns to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. The Defias papers recovered from the island are to go to the King's advisors through Gazin Tenorm. First, Duthorian Rall awaits word of the initiate's success.
sections.title: Return to the Cathedral

sections.body: Calling on the Light to restore the dead is no small gift. Duthorian Rall sees mastery of the Symbol of Life as proof that an initiate has the faith and spiritual strength for one of the paladin order's highest callings: resurrection. With this rite mastered, the paladin can safeguard allies on battlefields across the kingdom.
sections.title: The Gift of Resurrection

summary: In Stormwind, paladins face a trial of faith in The Tome of Divinity. An initiate proves mastery of the Symbol of Life by restoring a fallen ally, then earns Duthorian Rall's blessing to wield resurrection.
